customer_boundary: separate OpenClaw Fleet cell per account on a service-operated VPS
untrusted_code_isolation_candidate: gVisor runsc or a verified equivalent

planned_upgrade_not_purchased.purpose: later capacity increase; same accounts, routes and feature implementation

feature_policy: Keep every planned feature in scope; enable each implemented feature after its capability, isolation and budget checks, independent of hardware size.
worker_stage_policy: sequential; account-specific; measured resource admission before each stage
invitation_policy: operator_invite_only; at most two trial accounts; onboarding does not automatically start a Gateway
capacity_shortage_policy: bounded queue or explicit capacity-blocked status; no provider call or worker start without admission
current_host_admission_note: Historical default-2GiB-cell assessment; smaller on-demand profile has not been measured. Zero is not a ban on building the existing-host trial.
trial_acceptance_profile: two_accounts_one_global_task; parallel runtime acceptance remains required before increasing concurrency
